content_sections.heading: MGCU Graduate Apprentice Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the MGCU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: MGCU Graduate Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the MGCU recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Mahatma Gandhi Central University recruitment is Graduate Apprentice.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Graduate Apprentice post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies for the Graduate Apprentice post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Graduate Apprentice post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Graduate Apprentice post is Rs. 15,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum qualification required for the Graduate Apprentice post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is a Graduate in any Discipline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the walk-in date for the MGCU Graduate Apprentice recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in date for the MGCU Graduate Apprentice recruitment is 26 August 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Pt. Rajkumar Shukla Sabhagar, Chanakya Parisar, Zila School Campus, Motihari – 845401, Bihar.

faq.question: Q8. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The reporting time for the walk-in interview is 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the apprenticeship training?
faq.answer: The apprenticeship training is for a duration of twelve (12) months.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry original documents and self-attested copies of ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).
